τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’)
τίνες: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. pl., predicate of an infinitive · also predicate of a finite verb (εἰμί): τίνες ἐστέ; ’who are you?’ · also interrog. adj. + noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’what’ (τίνες κοῦροι)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
τίσω: τίνω — pay (a penalty), pay for; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will pay’
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τετεύχαται: τεύχω — make, do, work; perf. pass. 3 pl., Ionic -αται (= Attic -νται): ’have been done’
τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
τηλεμάχου: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
τιμῆς: τιμή — honour, worth; fem. gen. sg.
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιγὰρ: τοιγάρ — well then, accordingly; particle introducing a response to a request
τοιοῦτον: τοιοῦτος — such, of this kind; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with νόημα: ’such (a thought)’
τοκῆες: τοκεύς — parent, begetter (from τίκτω); nom. pl.
τούτων: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this, that; gen. pl.: ’of these’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’)
τοῦδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. gen. sg., elided (τοῦδ’ = τοῦδε)
τοῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. sg., elided (τοῦτ’ = τοῦτο)
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’; may anticipate a following clause: ’this (namely that…)’ · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (φάρμακον … τό σφιν πόρε ’the drug which she gave them’)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg.: ’him’; also relative: ’whom’ · also demonstrative with a noun, ’that’, antecedent of a relative: ἄνδρα τόν, ὅς κε … ’that man who …’
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much’
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’)
φάθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (φάθ’ = φάτο before rough breathing): ’so he spoke’
φίλ: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg., elided (φίλ’ = φίλε)
φίλε: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg.
φίλοιο: φίλος — dear; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
φίλοισι: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); masc. dat. pl.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν)
φαίδιμον: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. acc. sg.
φιλέει: φιλέω — love, be fond of; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φιλεῖ)
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φῦλον: φῦλον — tribe, race, kind; neut. acc. sg.
χαῖρε: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 sg., the ordinary greeting: ’welcome, hail’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔχαιρε): ’he rejoiced’ (χαῖρε φήμῃ ’rejoiced at the omen-word’) · also the imperative at parting: ’farewell’ · also with a dative of cause, ’be glad’ (χαῖρε … φιλότητι ’be glad in love’)
χλαῖνάν: χλαῖνα — a thick woollen cloak; fem. acc. sg.
χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration
ψαμάθῳ: ψάμαθος — sand, sandy shore; fem. dat. sg.
ψυχὴ: ψυχή — soul, spirit, ghost; fem. nom. sg.
ἀγαυοὶ: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; adj., masc. nom. pl.
ἀγγέλλων: ἀγγέλλω — announce, bring word; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’announcing’
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
ἀγορεύσω: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare; fut. 1 sg.
ἀγορεύω: ἀγορεύω — speak, speak in assembly; pres. 1 sg.
ἀγόρευσον: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare; aor. imper. 2 sg.
ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
ἀκέων: ἀκέων — silent, in silence; adj., masc. nom. sg., used adverbially: ’silently’
ἀκουὴν: ἀκουή — hearing, news, tidings, report; fem. acc. sg.
ἀλαλήμενος: ἀλάομαι — wander; perf. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated, epic (ἀλαλήμενος) ’wandered’
ἀληθέα: ἀληθής — true; adj., neut. acc. pl.: ‘the truth, true things’
ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); gen. sg.
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
ἀντιθέοιο: ἀντίθεος — godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen.
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπόλωλε: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid./pass. perish; perf. 3 sg.: ’has perished and is gone’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀτιμάζει: ἀτιμάζω — dishonour, slight, scorn; pres. 3 sg.
ἀτρεκέως: ἀτρεκής — exact, unswerving; adv. ἀτρεκέως: ’exactly, precisely’
ἀφίκεο: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive, come to; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀφίκου)
ἀφνειὸς: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; masc. nom. sg.
ἃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. acc. pl.: ’what things’ (ἃ μενοινᾷς ’what you desire’) · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: neut. acc. pl. ’his own’ (τὰ ἃ ἔργα ’his own tasks’)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλοθ: ἄλλοτε — at another time, elsewhere, ever again; adv., elided (ἄλλοθ’ = ἄλλοτε)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλως: ἄλλως — otherwise, in another way; adv.
ἄλοχον: ἄλοχος — wife, one who shares the bed; acc. sg.
ἄνακτα: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. acc. sg.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄπο: ἀπό — away from, from; + gen.; accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (anastrophe: φίλων ἄπο) · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὀλέσαντ’ ἄπο = ἀπολέσαντα ’having lost’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἅπαντα: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl., subject or object of a verb: ’all things’ (τελευτηθῆναι ἅπαντα ’that all things were fulfilled’)
ἐάσομεν: ἐάω — let, allow; leave off, give up; fut. 1 pl., used hortatively: ’let us leave off’ · also with an object, ’we will let (him) be’ (τοῦτον μὲν ἐάσομεν)
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows) · also accented ἐγώ before the enclitic μιν that follows
ἐγών: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., epic form with ν (= ἐγώ)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐδωδῇ: ἐδωδή — food, meat; fem. dat. sg.
ἐκείνου: κεῖνος (= ἐκεῖνος) — that, that one; demonstrative pron., masc. gen. sg.
ἐλεύσεσθαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; fut. inf. mid.
ἐλεύσεται: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — come, go; fut. 3 sg. mid.
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐμοῖσιν: ἐμός — my, mine; adj., masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἐμὰ: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἐμὴν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνίσπες: ἐνέπω/ἐνίσπω — tell, relate, declare; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’tell!’
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐνιαυτὸν: ἐνιαυτός — year; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a year’
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’)
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a generalizing conditional clause, without a further ἄν/κε: ἐπὴν κρητῆρι μιγείη ’when it has been mixed’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐτήτυμον: ἐτήτυμος — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly’
ἐφίλει: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was fond of, cherished’
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα)
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἑοῖσιν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη)
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may... come’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if ... should come’ (εἰ καί ποθεν ἄλλοθεν ἔλθοι)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv. (distinct from the by-form ἔνδοθι, also ’within’)
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (κακὸν … ἔργον τε ἔπος τε μελέτω ’let no evil deed or word be a care’) · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition/predicative, naming a maker: ἔργον Ἡφαίστοιο ’the work of Hephaestus’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a passive verb: ’work’ (τόδε ἔργον ἀέξεται ’this work grows’)
ἔστω: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let there be’ · also as a copula with a predicate, personal: ’let (no one) be (gentle, etc.)’ (μή τις … πρόφρων … ἔστω ’let no one be ready-minded’)
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided (ἔτ’ = ἔτι)
ἔτρεφον: τρέφω — nurture, rear, feed; impf. 1 sg.: ’I nurtured, I fed’
ἔφην: φημί — say, declare; impf. 1 sg., augmented, ἐ- before the consonant-initial stem φη-: ’I said’
ἕκαστα: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally: ’each thing, everything’ · also adjectival, with a noun: ’each piece’ (ὅπλα ἕκαστα) · also neut. nom. pl. in apposition: ’each’ (πεντήκοντα δ’ ἕκαστα ’fifty to each’)
ἕκηλος: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; masc. nom. sg.
ἠέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic = ἤ), esp. in ἠέ ... ἦ ’either... or’
ἠγαθέην: ἠγάθεος — very sacred, holy; fem. acc. sg. ἠγαθέην, agreeing with Πύλον (here treated as fem., as often in this formula)
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἠμείβετο, elided ἠμείβετ’)
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠπείρου: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; gen. sg.
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ἡ γὰρ δμώων δίκη ’for the way of servants’)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative: μεῖζον … ἤ ’greater than’
ἤγαγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 pl., reduplicated · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I brought’ (ἤγαγον ἐκ Σκύρου ’I brought him from Scyros’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤπιον: ἤπιος — gentle, kind, mild; masc. acc. sg., predicate with an infinitive: ’kind (to you)’
ἤραρε: ἀραρίσκω — fit, join; here transitive and figurative, aor. 3 sg. act.: ’fitted, satisfied’ (θυμὸν ἐδωδῇ ’satisfied his heart with food’)
ἤσθιε: ἐσθίω — eat; impf. 3 sg.: ’was eating, ate’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to see’
ἰδών: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having seen’
ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg.
ἰόντα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going, as he goes’
ἰότητι: ἰότης — will, wish, favour; fem. dat. sg.: ’by the will of’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱέμενός: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. press forward, be eager; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἴστω: οἶδα — know; perf. imper. 3 sg.: ’let it/him/her know’ (calling something to witness)
ἵκηται: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. (short ι; subjunctives take no augment)
ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. nom. sg., with οὔρεϊ: ’equal to a mountain’ · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’equally, as much as’ (ἶσον Ἀχιλλῆος … ἀχνύμεθα ’we grieve as much as for Achilles’)
ὀδυσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀδύρομαι: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn, grieve; pres. 1 sg.
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind; in Homer also ’hereafter, in time to come’; adv. · also ’back, home again’, of return (οἴκαδ’ ὀπίσσω ’back home’)
ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
ὀστεόφιν: ὀστέον — bone; neut. pl. in -φιν, an epic gen./dat. ending (= Attic ὀστῶν/ὀστέοις)
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’)
ὁμῶς: ὁμῶς — alike, in like manner, equally; adv.
ὁπποίης: ὁποῖος — of what sort; interrog./indef. adj. used directly, fem. gen. sg., double π epic (Ionic η for Attic α)
ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause · also introducing an indirect question, + pres. indic.: ’when’ (ὁππότε Τηλέμαχος νεῖτ(αι) ’when Telemachus is to return’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄληται: ὄλλυμαι — perish, be lost, be destroyed; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (μή + subj.: ’lest … perish’)
ὄρχαμος: ὄρχαμος — chief, leader; masc. nom. sg. (ὄρχαμος ἀνδρῶν ’chief of men’)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν) · also temporal ’until’ + opt., of a hoped-for event (ὄφρ’ ἐξεμέσειεν ’until she should vomit out’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε · also ’as, however’ + subj. in a general clause: ὅπως ἐθέλῃσιν ’however he wishes’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might follow’ (ὅπως … ἑποίατο) · also + pres. indic., ’as, in whatever way’ (ὅπως ἐθέλεις ’as you wish’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅσσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος (double σ), neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’as many as’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄχεϊ: ’her own (grief)’
ῥινὸν: ῥινός — hide, skin; also a shield of hide; acc. sg. (its sense in the simile εἴσατο δ’ ὡς ὅτε ῥινόν was disputed in antiquity)
